method: Direct ChatGPT AI-assisted literal semantic reading of seven 400-line excerpts and one 200-line excerpt of original numbered Git blob

source_only_findings.summary: B034 direct original historical source-only reading: Black Hills Washington’s Breakfast South/Central American beans explicitly Light (roaster calls city roast) rather than treating the ‘Medium’ retail grind option as roast, with natural sweetness a sensory phrase not Natural processing, and president-name not a producer. Pinewood Kibaya selected Rwanda/Kigali washed Red Bourbon at 1600–2000m by regional smallholders, with Rwamatamu washing station distinct from grower; its roast widget 2/5 with labels at Light/Medium/Dark provides no named second-step roast enum. Pinewood Hacienda Rio Negro selected Costa Rica Coto Brus washed Mixed at 1000–1300m; center 3/5 explicitly Medium, source tasting ‘Cantelope’ verbatim, sister Hacienda La Minita is stewardship not a blend component and Beneficio Rio Negro is mill. Pinewood Coast Decaf exact same-product description calls Mexican coffees natural sugar decaffeination but specification calls origin ‘African Blend’; story molasses/brown sugar conflicts with widget peaches/golden raisins/juicy; withhold origin and tasting notes, label washed/cultivar/elevation as dependent on disputed geographic spec, and do not misclassify sugar decaf as Natural/Honey bean processing. Cumbre Cafezinho Brazil original selected Cerrado/Mogiana/Sul de Minas, smallholders, 600–1200m, Natural, Medium, Catuai and source-spelling Mundo Novo/Mondo Nuovo; harvest May–Aug is season not product release year, and Santos is a trade label not farm region. All Shopify sizes, seller Espresso/Drip grind selectors, repeated SKUs and shipping weights are commerce, not espresso shot dose, yield, time or machine grinder settings; no current live app/roaster/auth source defect proven.
